verified_facts.text: Alexander Hotel occupies several floors of Torre Virreyes, one of the final works of Mexican modernist architect Teodoro Gonzalez de Leon.
verified_facts.excerpt: occupying several floors of Torre Virreyes, one of the final works of Teodoro González de León, the late Mexican modernist

verified_facts.text: Chapultepec park is directly across the street from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: it does offer guests access to the Chapultepec park directly across the street

verified_facts.text: Chapultepec park is home to the Museo Nacional de Antropologia, Museo Tamayo and Chapultepec Castle.
verified_facts.excerpt: It’s the largest urban park in Latin America and is home to the Museo Nacional de Antropología, Museo Tamayo, and Chapultepec Castle.

verified_facts.text: The neighborhood of Polanco is a five-minute drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: the neighborhood of Polanco is a five-minute drive away

verified_facts.text: Lomas de Virreyes is a financial district and residential pocket that isn't necessarily a walking neighborhood, mostly surrounded by embassies and law firms rather than cafes or galleries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lomas de Virreyes is a financial district and residential pocket of Mexico City, and isn’t necessarily a walking neighborhood. It’s mostly surrounded by embassies and law firms, not cafés or galleries.

verified_facts.text: The Alexander Suite has a 180-degree view of Chapultepec Park through expansive windows, plus a deep soaking tub and rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: This 80.42 m² sanctuary reveals a stunning 180° view of Chapultepec Park through expansive windows. It features spacious living and dining areas, a king-size bed, and a luxurious bathroom with a deep soaking tub and rain shower.

verified_facts.text: All rooms have king beds and floor-to-ceiling windows that open toward either the skyline or Chapultepec.
verified_facts.excerpt: All have king beds and floor-to-ceiling windows that open either toward the skyline or the green expanse of Chapultepec.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have blue calcite marble bathrooms, dark ebony wood and leather accents, Bang & Olufsen speakers and Byredo toiletries.
verified_facts.excerpt: The interiors feature blue calcite marble in the bathrooms, dark ebony wood and leather accents in the main area, and in-room amenities including Bang & Olufsen speakers and Byredo toiletries.

verified_facts.text: The bathrooms are glass-walled but have a heavy curtain for privacy.
verified_facts.excerpt: The bathrooms are glass-walled, but offer a heavy curtain for privacy if you want it.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a Petrossian caviar bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: complete with a Petrossian caviar bar

verified_facts.text: The spa has two private treatment rooms and steam cabins.
verified_facts.excerpt: private treatment rooms and steam cabins,

verified_facts.text: The gym offers private sessions with a trainer, a jogging coach and a yoga instructor.
verified_facts.excerpt: sessions from our trainer, jogging coach,

verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed by architect Daniel Alvarez Fernandez, with interiors by Lorena Cherem and Linda Masri of Ambia Studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel itself was designed by Daniel Álvarez Fernández of Grupo Arquitectura, with interiors by Lorena Cherem and Linda Masri of Ambia Studio.

verified_facts.text: Contemporary artworks curated by Nicole Badin are integrated throughout the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: contemporary artworks are integrated throughout

verified_facts.text: Alexander opened in 2023 as the first hotel from Namron Hospitality Group.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alexander opened in 2023 as the first hotel from Namron Hospitality Group

verified_facts.text: A lifestyle concierge can arrange experiences such as a tour of Frida Kahlo's Casa Azul or a private driver to Teotihuacan.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s also a lifestyle concierge to help book all sorts of experiences or answer any questions, from arranging a tour of Frida Kahlo's Casa Azul to coordinating a private driver to Teotihuacán.

verified_facts.text: E-bikes are available for guests to borrow.
verified_facts.excerpt: E-bikes are available for borrowing

verified_facts.text: All suites and common areas are wheelchair-accessible via glass elevators.
verified_facts.excerpt: All suites and common areas are wheelchair-accessible via glass elevators

verified_facts.text: The hotel is technically family-friendly, but the aesthetic skews strongly toward adults.
verified_facts.excerpt: Technically yes, but the aesthetic skews strongly toward adults

verified_facts.text: The Grand Hall is a light-filled event space with a mega screen and park views.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sophisticated, light-filled event space

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World and is operated by Namron Hospitality Group.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Leading Hotels of the World; operated by Namron Hospitality Group

verified_facts.text: Several restaurants, including Carmela y Sal, are inside the Torre Virreyes building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests don’t even need to leave the Torre Virreyes building to dine at a few other top restaurants in the area, including the aforementioned Carmela y Sal
